_comment: Labelled cases for drift invariant 60's claim detector. tools/sync_check.py::_claim_case_problems reads them and documents what each list means; check_claim_proof fails the build when the detector disagrees with any case, and _claim_case_blindness fails it when a branch narrowed to its first positive still passes every case. A regression pin, not a precision measurement.

each: Each requirements set installs into the repo .venv.
The checker computes drift from each registry entry's own pin.
